entities.summary: Javokhir Sindarov is an Uzbek chess grandmaster. A chess prodigy, he became a grandmaster at the age of 12 years, 10 months, and 8 days. He is a two-time national champion, and was part of the Uzbek team that won the 44th Chess Olympiad.
